_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base-rate plus two-sided extremes and no macro catalyst inside 24h leave the score inside Denial with no breaker for up or down.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on phase (Denial) and on non-directional stance; narrative is too thin to contradict analyst HOLD/CAUTION
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound, fear_greed holds ~25-40, phase score remains 32-38 with no volume expansion
next_move.invalidated_if: Fast flush (fear_greed into teens, funding negative, score into Panic) or reclaim (ETF flows positive and score through 39 into Anxiety)
